decision_basis.athlete_direction: Postpone the Enduro bike until next week and focus on the Stumpjumper at the newly reached higher speed and intensity.
decision_basis.tuesday_cost: The 2026-07-28 Stumpjumper session produced Garmin load 218.3, aerobic/anaerobic TE 4.0/2.8, RPE 10, and a triggered_but_continued stop outcome. Thursday is available only if 48-hour recovery is genuinely clean.
decision_basis.setup_history: The current slower fork rebound was a successful correction for big-hit front ping that pushed Clayton rearward. A prior HSC +1 test felt excellent at maximum attack on 2K+ through successive hits; HSC was later returned one click softer during illness-related fatigue.
decision_basis.test_priority: Validate HSC +1 as a fresh-rider attack setting without changing rebound, shock, tyre pressure, cockpit, cleats, or route intent.

session.title: Stumpjumper HSC attack-setting validation — 2K+ then conditional Pure Quill
session.purpose: Test whether one additional click of fork HSC restores high-speed large-impact support and intended steering on the Stumpjumper while preserving the slower rebound setting that previously removed big-hit front ping.

dose.preconditions: Run same-day Garmin sync/current-state/coach-packet. Require non-red physical readiness, CNS ready, normal subjective clarity and body feel, no illness, and a completely clear cold tyre/wheel/axle/headset/fork/shock/linkage/frame inspection.
dose.setup: Before riding, add exactly one click of fork HSC relative to the 2026-07-28 setting. Keep fork rebound, shock settings, tyre pressures, cockpit, and cleats unchanged.
dose.opening_gate: Ten to fifteen minutes at RPE 2-3 with figure eights, deliberate bike-body separation, symmetric steering, progressive front loading, and no unexplained leftward tendency.
dose.first_descent: Ride 2K+ at approximately 85 percent execution. Use the known successive-hit sections to assess fork support, recovery, tyre contact, intended steering, and whether Clayton can remain dynamically centred rather than retreating rearward.
dose.post_2k_plus_gate: Pure Quill is earned only if the fork tracks without ping or harsh lateral deflection, steering remains fully intentional, no rear wallow/kick or chassis pitch appears, vision and decision speed are unchanged, braking and upper-body fatigue remain no more than 2/10, and the preceding climb is no higher than RPE 5.
dose.second_descent: If the gate passes, ride one Pure Quill at 85-90 percent. This is a support and steering validation, not a maximum-speed attempt or segment chase.
dose.egress: Use the required exit at transport pace. It is not a third setup or speed test.
dose.hard_cap: One 2K+, one conditional Pure Quill, and required egress; 85-100 minutes expected and 105 minutes absolute cap. No additional stage or repeat.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: When Clayton is fresh enough to load the bike actively, HSC +1 should hold the fork higher through rapid large-impact compression, preserve chassis geometry and front-tyre authority, and prevent the rearward retreat that amplified rear wallow and leftward steering on 2026-07-28.
execution_rules: Higher speed is the validation endpoint, not the opening dose.
Keep the previously successful slower fork rebound unchanged; do not test rebound and HSC together.
Use only familiar lines and keep braking points deliberate. Do not enter the impact sequence already rearward.
Record whether any failure occurs on the first impact or accumulates through successive hits, plus fork O-ring travel and whether the fork recovers between hits.
No standing-torque target, sprint, VO2 interval, jump progression, or alternate trail.
For approximately 95-105 minutes in Kuala Lumpur heat, target 45-60 g carbohydrate, 650-900 ml fluid, and 600-900 mg sodium per hour.

expected_result.technical: 2K+ and the conditional Pure Quill hold the intended line through large and successive hits without front ping, left pull, reactive correction, rearward retreat, rear wallow/kick, or chassis pitch.
expected_result.setup: HSC +1 provides more large-impact support while retaining useful tyre compliance; normal small-hit tracking and root/rock conformity do not deteriorate.
expected_result.physiology: Climbs remain RPE 2-5 and whole-session RPE approximately 5-7, with no deliberate engine interval.
expected_result.garmin_training_load: Approximately 120-175 if the full conditional route is completed as written.
expected_result.next_session: Friday may be a short HSC -1 chill/compliance ride only if Thursday remains within the contract and Friday recovery is clean.

stop_rules: Replace the ride with recovery if physical readiness is red, CNS readiness is impaired/compromised, data is stale, subjective clarity/body feel is abnormal, or the opening gate shows an unexplained leftward tendency.
Any unresolved pressure loss, tyre/casing/bead fault, wheel or hub play, axle/headset/fork issue, suspension leak/knock, linkage play, or frame concern blocks trail testing.

Do not earn Pure Quill if the 2K+ climb exceeds RPE 5 or if 2K+ produces front ping/deflection, unintended steering, rearward retreat, rear wallow/kick, pitch, reactive braking, line correction, or fatigue above 2/10.
Any inability to steer the intended line immediately ends technical speed. Use the safest easy exit and do not repeat the feature.
Do not exceed 90 percent because HSC +1 feels excellent; no maximum-speed pass.
